# Phase 02: Core Plugins & Infrastructure

## Purpose

Rewrite all Nuxt 2 plugins as Nuxt 4 `defineNuxtPlugin()` equivalents, replace the Vue-instance-based localForage wrapper, introduce `mitt` as the event bus replacement, and migrate the icon and notification systems.

## Shared Context

- Nuxt 4 auto-discovers plugins in `app/plugins/` — no explicit registration needed
- Plugin ordering: use `order` property or file naming (`01.localforage.ts`) for load order
- `defineNuxtPlugin()` receives `nuxtApp` with `nuxtApp.vueApp` for global registrations
- `Vue.prototype.$x` → `nuxtApp.provide('x', value)` + access via `useNuxtApp().$x`
- `Vue.filter()` removed in Vue 3 — export as plain functions and call directly
- `Vue.component()` → `nuxtApp.vueApp.component()` or auto-import from `components/`
- `Vue.use()` → `nuxtApp.vueApp.use()` (only if plugin needs Vue app integration)
- The old localForage plugin wraps each store in a `new Vue()` instance — must replace with plain class
- Event bus (`this.$root.$on/off/emit`) used in ~10 files — replace with `mitt`

## Key Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `plugins/localForage.js` | Generated by nuxt module — wraps localForage in Vue instances |
| `modules/localForage.js` | Nuxt 2 module (flattened from `modules/nuxtModules/` in p01-02) |
| `plugins/cordova.js` | Platform detection, `vue-cordova`, `localePath` injection |
| `plugins/icons/index.js` | Registers `<Icon>` and `<Icons>` globally |
| `plugins/icons/Icon.vue` | Individual icon component |
| `plugins/icons/Icons.vue` | SVG sprite sheet component |
| `plugins/filters.js` | Vue.filter + Vue.prototype.$filters |
| `plugins/vue-notifications.js` | SweetAlert2 injection |
| `plugins/router.js` | afterEach hook syncing to Vuex routes store |

## Constraints

- localForage plugin must expose same 4 stores: `files`, `blobs`, `about`, `article`
- Icon components must be globally available (used in multiple pages without import)
- `mitt` bus must be provided app-wide via `useNuxtApp().$bus`
- Router plugin depends on Pinia routes store (Phase 03) — write plugin, wire to Pinia later
- Filters must be importable as plain functions AND available as `$filters` for gradual migration
